notes_for_editor: Thin record: no build date, staffing, owner or removal date found for this site. A UW-Madison Libraries digital record (Town of Harrison material, id AEIACW55H2OKKT8Q) appeared in search results and seems to describe an earlier site on a farm in the town of Harrison, erected about 1934, and a move around 1939-40. The cached copy is only library page chrome, so none of that text is quoted or used; an editor with a working viewer should check it. If confirmed it would add built and relocated events and change the story. Coordinate mismatch: firelookout and OpenStreetMap give 45.03104, -89.26429; the central-US record in data/sources/central_us_lookouts.json gives 45.0489, -89.2342, about 3 km away. The story uses the firelookout coordinates. Ownership is unknown. The 2015 and 2019 DNR figures are statewide context only and do not establish that Aniwa was a DNR tower. The WXPR build dates refer to the towers in service at the time, not to Aniwa specifically.
